exposure: blood group type (ABO and Rh positive)
cohort: The study included 240 pregnant women from Northwest Ethiopia, with 120 diagnosed with pregnancy-induced hypertension and 120 without PIH.
finding: Pregnant women with pregnancy-induced hypertension had a significantly higher incidence of gestational diabetes mellitus (25.8%) compared to those without pregnancy-induced hypertension (6.7%).
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, from December 2021 to April 2022
